description: Meta tag generator client and server side from freedailypro — Open Graph + Twitter

description.description: The page description, used for the description and og:description tags.

image.description: The URL of the image to use in the og:image and twitter:image tags.

title.description: The page title, used for the title tag and og:title.

twitterCard.description: The Twitter card type to use (e.g. summary or summary_large_image). One of: summary, summary_large_image.

type.description: The Open Graph object type (e.g. website, article).

url.description: The page's URL, used for og:url.

name: generate_meta_tags
